raw_snapshot_statements.sentence: A partitioned survival model (PSM) was developed to simulate 3-week patients in 10-year time horizon to access the disease course and cost-effectiveness of sacituzumab tirumotecan compared with chemotherapy for metastatic TNBC patients, cost and utility values were gathered from the dataset and published studies, annual discount rate of 5% was used.
